card.name: Words leading into history or heritage
card.fires_on: A modifier or verb just before an expected word like history, heritage, origins or legacy, such as 'a long', 'its French', or 'has been around'. It marks places, groups or things described by their past.

modes.label: Long before history
modes.description: The word 'long' after 'a' or 'has a', ahead of history, memory or legacy.
modes.example: has a<< long>> history as an institution.

modes.label: Cultural or origin adjective
modes.description: An adjective after a possessive that names the source of a heritage or origin.
modes.example: represent a re-emergence of the day's<< pagan>> origins as a winter solstice ritual to

modes.label: Duration phrase
modes.description: A verb or article that leads into how long something has existed or a past record.
modes.example: Side-saddle riding<< has>> been around since ancient times

card.writes: It boosts history, background, roots and origins as the next word and suppresses unrelated pieces of other words.
card.plain: It fires on words that set up a mention of something's history, heritage or origins.
